fields.title: 📖 Whoever meets Allah without Shirk
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever meets Allah without **associating anything with Him** enters Paradise; and whoever meets Him with Shirk enters the Fire.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The greatest difference at the end is **Tawḥīd or Shirk**.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Īmān, Hadith Nr. 93; überliefert von Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh.
